name: R1 RCM
flags: Structurally different from the rest of this list - a large, PE-owned public-company-turned-private RCM incumbent (34K employees) rather than a young AI-native roll-up, though it fits the M&A pattern via Cloudmed/VisitPay/SCI Solutions.

prior_enrichment_2026_08_24.funding_detail: Public company (former NASDAQ: RCM) taken private by TowerBrook Capital Partners and Clayton, Dubilier & Rice (CD&R) in a deal that closed Nov 2024, valuing R1 at $8.9B. Not a traditional VC-funded startup.
prior_enrichment_2026_08_24.headcount: ~30,000-34,000 associates worldwide; large offshore delivery presence (India, etc.)
prior_enrichment_2026_08_24.past_completed_deals: Under Joe Flanagan's leadership R1 acquired VisitPay, SCI Solutions, and Cloudmed (advanced analytics/robotic process automation for revenue intelligence) - establishing R1 as a technology-led RCM platform. R1 itself began as Accretive Health (2003).
